lead.title: Microbiotica raises £36M Series C (first close) to test its gut-bacteria capsule in ulcerative colitis
lead.deck: Round led by the British Business Bank, with Tencent, IP Group, Cambridge Innovation Capital, Flerie Invest, Seventure Partners and all Series B investors. Proceeds fund a randomised, placebo-controlled Phase 2 of MB310, a once-daily capsule of eight live bacterial strains; in Phase 1b (29 adults), 12 of 19 patients on MB310 were in remission versus 3 of 10 on placebo (primary objective: safety).

milestone.title: Osivax: universal flu vaccine OVX836 misses its primary endpoint in Phase 2b
milestone.summary: In the Asuniva trial (2,850 adults aged 18–59, Belgium, France, Finland, Germany), efficacy was 24% against a 50% target, not statistically significant; secondary estimates were 28% against influenza-like illness, 27% against H3N2 and 25% against H1N1pdm09. Osivax is turning to combinations with seasonal flu vaccines (GC Biopharma deal in August).
milestone.why: A setback for the thesis of a broad-spectrum vaccine targeting the nucleoprotein, with no confidence intervals published; the path forward now runs through partnerships with established players.

deal.thesis: Lakefront (ex-Galapagos) sells five preclinical CAR-T assets to Belgian start-up Armed Cell: €8M upfront, up to $230M in milestones and low-single-digit royalties. India's Mankind Pharma takes 70% of Armed Cell for €48M, alongside a financing of over €50M to bring the programmes (non-Hodgkin lymphoma, small-cell lung cancer) into the clinic.

brefsEurope.title: Sibylla Biotech names Usman Azam (ex-Tmunity) CEO and Gianluca Fuggetta CFO
brefsEurope.summary: Azam led Tmunity Therapeutics and Novartis' cell and gene therapy unit. Sibylla aims for a first-in-human study of its Cyclin D1 protein degrader.

brefsEurope.title: AL-S Pharma: Harry Welten succeeds Michael Salzmann, AP-101 Phase 3 pushed to 2027
brefsEurope.summary: The company is preparing a confirmatory Phase 3 of AP-101 in ALS, now targeted for 2027 (previously late 2026).

brefsEurope.title: Beactica selects BEA-28, a TEAD degrader, for preclinical development
brefsEurope.summary: In mice, tumour regression in mesothelioma and KRAS-mutant lung cancer models; no human testing yet.

brefsEurope.title: BioNTech: mRNA vaccine BNT113 misses its primary endpoint (PFS) in the Phase 2/3 AHEAD-MERIT trial
brefsEurope.summary: BNT113 plus pembrolizumab did not significantly improve progression-free survival versus pembrolizumab alone in HPV16+ PD-L1+ head and neck cancer; the independent committee recommends continuing for overall survival (second primary endpoint).

brefsIntl.title: Estuary emerges from stealth with $103M for kidney-disease gene therapies
brefsIntl.summary: Announced by Fierce Biotech on Oct 16: stealth exit with a $103M round (investors not detailed here), a gauge of US gene-therapy funding.

word.definition: A medicine containing live micro-organisms (bacteria or yeast) intended to prevent or treat a disease, and that is not a vaccine.

how.t: Bacterial strains linked to a clinical effect are identified, often from healthy donors' microbiota.
Strains are produced under controlled conditions and formulated, e.g. as a once-daily oral capsule.
The product is tested like a drug: safety first, then efficacy versus placebo (Microbiotica is entering Phase 2 in ulcerative colitis).

word.why: A distinct class of medicines recognised by the FDA and EMA, with drug-level evidence requirements but unusual manufacturing chemistry. European rounds are multiplying (Microbiotica, Mbiomics), with a first microbiome marketing application under EMA review at MaaT Pharma.
